# Top Finish Tile & Construction
> Flooring services in Hillsboro, Oregon and the Portland metro. Oregon CCB #259374. (503) 713-1067.

## Services
- [Tile Installation](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/tile-installation/): floor and wall tile, showers, backsplashes. $9–$25 per sq ft installed
- [Shower & Bath Tile](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/shower-tile/): waterproofed shower pans, surrounds, niches, curbless entries. $3,500–$9,000
- [Hardwood Installation](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/hardwood-installation/): solid and engineered hardwood, nail-down and glue-down. $8–$16 per sq ft installed
- [Hardwood Refinishing](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/hardwood-refinishing/): sanding, staining, and finishing existing floors. $3–$7 per sq ft
- [Luxury Vinyl Plank](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/lvp-installation/): waterproof LVP and LVT, floating and glue-down. $4–$9 per sq ft installed
- [Laminate Flooring](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/laminate-flooring/): click-lock laminate, underlayment, transitions. $3–$7 per sq ft installed
- [Carpet Installation](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/carpet-installation/): carpet, pad, stairs, and old flooring removal. $3–$8 per sq ft installed
- [Subfloor Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/subfloor-repair/): rot, soft spots, squeaks, and leveling. $400–$2,500
- [Floor Leveling](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/floor-leveling/): self-leveling compound and grinding. $2–$5 per sq ft
- [Backsplash Installation](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/backsplash-installation/): kitchen and bar backsplashes. $600–$1,800
- [Flooring Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/floor-repair/): cracked tile, damaged boards, transitions. $250–$1,200
- [Stairs & Treads](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/stair-treads/): hardwood treads, risers, nosing, carpet-to-wood. $120–$300 per stair
- [Grout & Caulk Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/grout-repair/): regrouting, resealing, caulk replacement. $300–$900
- [Commercial Flooring](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/top-finish-tile-construction-llc/services/commercial-flooring/): LVT, sheet goods, and tile for shops and offices. Quoted by square footage
